desc: Navigator and diagrams for SysML v2 text models: requirement coverage, traceability, impact analysis, structure, connection, state and action diagrams.
cfg.followNavigator: When enabled, the editor jumps to the matching location whenever the focus in the navigator changes. Otherwise only when a line link is clicked.
cfg.include: Glob pattern for the model files the viewer reads.
cfg.exclude: Glob pattern for folders that are skipped (e.g. the standard library).
cfg.liveUpdate: Update the view while typing (unsaved changes), not only on save.
